title: ci: check out Type Check UI at depth 1 and give every history fetch a budget sized to its job
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb2CZ7ohopLMiBhAucfDgqvA)_

domain:devx#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRSntnsNKYKPXp9kFG

Refs #22034

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:根 `ci.yml` 的 `Type Check UI`(`type-check-ui`)也不再用 `fetch-depth: 0`,改为深度 1 检出,加上与 Test Core / Test UI 逐字相同的一步"取当前提交的完整祖先 + main(及 PR 目标分支)",不取 tag 和其它分支;四个 job 的这一步各自加超时,按各自 job 墙钟留出的余量定:test-plan 8 分钟、test-ui 14、test 20、type-check-ui 20;新增一条测试钉住"四个 job 都是深度 1 + 紧跟取历史步骤 + 预算不低于 8 分钟且小于 job 墙钟",两条原本钉 `fetch-depth: 0` 的测试改钉取历史步骤。
- 为什么改:#22034 第二步的第二个 PR,收尾第一个 PR(#31429)留下的四件事。注意实测:健康日新路径并不更快,三个 job 合并看中位数约慢 5 秒(新 62 秒 vs 旧 57 秒),其中 test-plan 慢 14 秒;收益在故障尾部——去掉的 1.5k 分支和 1.7 万 tag 正是 11-03 事故里慢 5.6–6.5 倍、10-13 三次传输失败的那部分负载。两组分布及 n 见下方 Acceptance notes。
- 风险与回滚:风险是 `Type Check UI` 的读者拿不到历史;已逐个核对四个读者(lockfile 告警、i18n 漂移、受影响 type-check 范围、spec 构建)都由这一步满足。取历史三次失败或超过该 job 的预算会让该步变红,而不是静默。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的 `type-check-ui` 检出与新步骤;`test` job 注释里新加的 FETCH BUDGET 段;`ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts` 末尾的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:打开本 PR 的 CI,看 `Type Check UI` 的 "Fetch this commit's history and the base branch" 日志打印 `shallow=false, no tags`,且该 job 整体为绿。
- 需要你做的:合并本 PR(受管 `.github/workflows/**`,Tier H,须维护者手合)。

## What changes

Five files; only `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is a workflow.

1. **`type-check-ui` checks out at depth 1** and runs the fetch step right after the checkout. The `with:` / `fetch-depth: 0` block and its comment are gone. The step is identical, but for its budget, to the three copies #31429 added in `test-plan`, `test` and `test-ui`: `git fetch --no-tags --unshallow origin HEAD_SHA +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main`, plus the PR's base branch when it is not `main`, three attempts, then a red step. Its comment names this job's readers.
2. **Each fetch step takes its own `timeout-minutes`, sized inside its job's wall:** `test-plan` 8, `test-ui` 14, `test` 20, `type-check-ui` 20. Besides the budget, the four copies change in one line: the shared `::error::` now reads "This job's history readers need it, so this job stops here rather than reading from a shallow clone". The old text named the package selection, which is not the reader in `test-ui` or `type-check-ui`. `test`'s comment gains a FETCH BUDGET paragraph with the sizing (below). The other copies' comments say "verbatim but for its budget".
3. **Pins.**
   - New `describe` in `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts`. It runs one case per job (`test-plan`, `test`, `test-ui`, `type-check-ui`), reading the parsed YAML. Each case checks that the `actions/checkout` step sets no `fetch-depth`, that the next step is the fetch step, that its budget is a number of at least 8 and under the job's own `timeout-minutes`, and that the job's first history reader comes after it. A fifth case asserts the four fetch steps are deep-equal once `timeout-minutes` is removed.
   - `check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts` and `check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts` asserted `fetch-depth: 0` on `type-check-ui`. They now assert the fetch step sits before their gate's step.
4. **Prose.**
   - `ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`: the shallow-clone refusal said "In CI, give the checkout `fetch-depth: 0`". It now says to fetch HEAD's history and the base branch after the checkout.
   - In `ci.yml`, two comments that cited `fetch-depth: 0` as the source of `refs/remotes/origin/*` and of the merge base now name the fetch step.

⛔ Not in this PR: any other line of the fetch step, `select-shard-packages.sh`, any other job or workflow, and `ui/.github/**`.

## Why

Card #22034, step 2, second PR, released by the maintainer's 「以上都同意」 (recorded 6718334937). It closes what the first PR's hand-off (6723904729) and contract review 6718987786 ③ left: the same fetch step for `type-check-ui`, a depth-1 pin, a sized fetch budget, and the stale `fetch-depth: 0` prose. The step-1 reading is 6724659023. The seat's rulings are on the amended claim.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run` (from `ui/`) on `select-affected-tests.test.ts`, `check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts`, `check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts` and `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`: 4 files, 148 tests passed on `d69b4e47` (`@objectstack/spec` built first; the drift test imports it).
- **Base red:** the same three pin files against `main`'s `ci.yml` (`dced781f`, restored into the tree, then `git restore --source=HEAD`): 7 failed. They are the four per-job cases, the deep-equal case, and the two moved pins.
- **Ablations** (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each restore left the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - On `6d8684a5`, re-adding `with: fetch-depth: 0` to `type-check-ui`'s checkout landed (anchor 1 → 0) and failed the `type-check-ui` case: "type-check-ui's checkout sets fetch-depth: expected +0 to be undefined" (1 failed, 55 passed).
  - On `d69b4e47`, raising `test-plan`'s fetch budget to its 10-minute wall landed and failed the `test-plan` case: "expected 10 to be less than 10" (1 failed, 55 passed).
  - On `d69b4e47`, adding one `env` key to the `test-ui` copy only landed and failed "the fetch step is one step, the same in all four jobs but for its budget" (1 failed, 55 passed).

## Acceptance notes

**The cost, plainly.** On healthy runs the depth-1 path is not faster: pooled over the three jobs it is about 5 s slower at the median, and `test-plan` is 14 s slower. The gain is the incident tail: the dropped 1.5k heads and 17k tags. Those slowed 5.6-6.5x in the 2026-11-03 incident, against about 3x for shallow fetches, and failed three times on transport on 2026-10-13. No incident fell in either window, so this reading does not measure that gain.

Both distributions come from the jobs API, `CI` on `main` (push) and `merge_group`. Times are in seconds, at 1 s grain.

| Window | Jobs (`test-plan` + `test` + `test-ui`) | n | p50 | p90 | p99 | max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Before #31429: "Checkout repository" with `fetch-depth: 0`, 178 runs, 2026-11-08 01:27Z–16:00Z | all three | 2504 | 57 | 64 | 87 | 143 |
| After: checkout + fetch step, 22 runs (8 push, 14 queue), 16:00Z–17:22Z | all three | 277 | 62 | 79 | 99 | 107 |
| After, fetch step alone | all three | 277 | 50 | 57 | 72 | 85 |

- **Per lane, p50 before → after:**
  - Plan Test Core shards: 57 → 71 (n 164 / 22).
  - Test Core (N/8): 57 → 62 (917 / 111).
  - Test UI (N/16): 58 → 60 (1423 / 144).
- **Control:** `Type Check UI`, still on full history in the same runs, read p50 53 → 51 (n 89 / 9). The two windows saw the same platform.
- **Fetch outcome:** 277 of 277 fetches succeeded. The slowest, 85 s (job 128790425643), ran one attempt.
- **Why it is not faster:** the fetch pulls HEAD's whole ancestry, about 20.7k commits. On CI that costs about what the old single full-ref clone did.
- **What `Type Check UI` should expect:** about the same shift. Its checkout read p50 53 s before; the new path reads about 60 s.
- **Full reading:** 6724659023, with method and per-event splits. The seat re-reads n at ACCEPT.

**The budgets: 8 / 14 / 20 / 20 minutes, each inside its job's wall.**
- **The rule:** each job gives the fetch what its wall leaves after its measured checkout and body (the max over 2026-11-08's runs), capped at 20 minutes. lint.yml's 25-minute CHECKOUT BUDGET is the same reading for its full-history checkouts.

| Job | Wall | Checkout max | Body max | Room | Budget |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `test-plan` | 10:00 | 0:24 | 0:37 | 8:59 | **8** |
| `test-ui` | 30:00 | 0:28 | 15:29 | 14:03 | **14** |
| `test` | 60:00 | 0:31 | 24:00 | 35:29 | **20** |
| `type-check-ui` | 40:00 | about 0:30 | 14:23 | about 25 | **20** |

- **Healthy floor:** the smallest budget, 480 s, still holds the fetch's max 85 s x 5.6 and its p99 72 s x 6.5. Those factors are the 2026-11-03 incident's slowdown of the full-ref fetch at the median. Three healthy attempts plus the 15 s and 30 s sleeps take 300 s.
- **The incident tail:** on 2026-11-03, full-history checkouts of 1063-1799 s cancelled 19 Test UI shards at their wall. This step pulls the whole ancestry, so I assume its tail is no shorter; that is unmeasured. 20 minutes holds the tail's low end (1063 s), not its top.
- **Per job:**
  - In `test` and `type-check-ui`, a fetch as slow as the tail's low end now finishes, where a uniform 8 would have gone red.
  - In `test-ui`, neither end of the tail fits beside the body inside the 30-minute wall, so the budget only ends the red sooner and names the step.
  - In `test-plan`, a red plan falls back to all eight shards, and each shard fetches for itself.

**`type-check-ui`'s readers (inventory rows 5-8 of #31429), re-read on `main` `467a01f7`, all answered by the same step:**

| Row | Reader | Answered because |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | `check:lockfile-integrity` (PR only, `continue-on-error`): `git merge-base origin/BASE HEAD`, `git show REV:pnpm-lock.yaml` | `origin/main` is always fetched, plus `origin/BASE` when the base is another branch; no partial-clone filter, so the blob is local. The step precedes it. |
| 6 | `check:i18n-drift`: `merge-base HEAD origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF`, then `origin/main` | On PR, `origin/BASE`. On queue and push, the merge base with `origin/main`, the same commit as under `fetch-depth: 0`. |
| 7 | the affected type-check scope, `turbo --filter=...[BASE]` with the payload `base.sha` or the queue `base_sha` | Both are ancestors of HEAD, so both are in the unshallowed ancestry. |
| 8 | spec's build (`build-schemas.ts`) | `merge-base HEAD origin/main`, as row 2. |

None of the job's 16 other `pnpm --dir ui run` checks, the local modules they import, or its `tsc` steps runs a history-reading git command.

**Left as found:**
- The `fetch-depth: 0` prescriptions in `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts`, `ui/scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` and `ui/scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs` are the seat's follow-up card, not this PR.
- `test`'s "NOT `fetch-depth: 0`" comment and the old-refspec description are history, and stay.

**Serial:** `git merge-tree --write-tree` of `d69b4e47` is clean against PR #31611's head `95c48c6f` and against `main` `c5361e2c`. `main`'s #31639 also edits `select-affected-tests.test.ts`; I ran that file and `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` with the merged contents in the tree: 78 passed.

## Verification

I derived the gate union with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 62 families for this diff, on head `d69b4e47`; the same 62 as on `6d8684a5`. I ran every one and captured each exit code before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 62 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".

- **All 62 exit 0.** Among them:
  - `pnpm check:required-contexts`, `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:shard-attestation`, `check:stall-guard-budget`, `check:stall-guard-headroom`, `check:aggregator-roster`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:pm-expected-skips`;
  - `node scripts/check-step-collectors.mjs`, `node scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs`, `node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test`;
  - `pnpm check:dts-closure` (256/256 declaration files across 80 packages) and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (122 entry points; both read the full build `check:type-check-debt` made);
  - `pnpm check:type-check-debt` under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0; on `6d8684a5` it also ran the full build the two lines above read);
  - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` ("2205 cases pass", fast tier);
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the lock (170 files passed, 2 skipped; 5014 tests passed);
  - `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` against this body.
- **Outside the derivation:**
  - `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: exit 3, "GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record", landing tier H, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` the one register path, 125 changed lines (under 3000).
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: exit 0, "no path-derived mandate".
  - The PR-body gates on this body (`check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`): each exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: the diff touches no package, so there is no scoped package lint.
- `main` moved 16 commits after the branch point (to `c5361e2c`). Only #31639 touches a file this PR changes, and it merges cleanly and passes (Serial above). Following the seat's ask, no new head was pushed for it.

`skip-changeset`: `.github/**` and `ui/scripts/**` ship in no package.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (test case names only)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no package touched)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the lane's required Chinese summary)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
